🗓️以太坊日报 2026-10-17

【区块链技术讨论】
1⃣@nero_eth、@kevaundray、@lightclients与@ignaciohagopian就EIP-8025展开激烈争论，核心分歧在于是否应以非承载方式提前引入SNARK/zkVM概念，以及该提案应归类为信息性EIP还是核心硬分叉议程，同时涉及对后续提案规范约束与状态丢弃风险的权衡 [原文] (https://x.com/nero_eth/status/2110955329139757262)

2⃣@nero_eth披露明年Hegotá分叉已有23个EIPs进入CFI/SFI状态，但仅FOCIL与Frame Transactions为SFI'd；强调AI虽加速开发，但治理协调需防范范围蔓延以确保安全可控 [原文] (https://x.com/nero_eth/status/2111038056597712979)

3⃣@pcaversaccio分析EIP-8246拟移除SELFDESTRUCT燃烧机制，指出当前超26,792 ETH存于主要燃烧地址但开发者普遍不知协议级不可逆燃烧，主张引入一级燃烧原语真正从供应中移除ETH [原文] (https://x.com/pcaversaccio/status/2111108120990892251)

4⃣@ralexstokes宣布Glamsterdam升级推进，Hoodi测试网定于10月26日激活，主网日期待另行公布，相关客户端版本与漏洞赏金计划已发布 [原文] (https://x.com/ralexstokes/status/2111165223780454451)

5⃣@gballet称"Lean is the new rust"，暗示形式验证语言Lean正成为以太坊协议开发的新范式 [原文] (https://x.com/gballet/status/2111041690916057345)

6⃣@nero_eth与@BenDiFrancesco等认为某测试网钱包使用公开开发者恢复短语派生密钥并非严重安全问题，属已知测试惯例 [原文] (https://x.com/nero_eth/status/2110996334064873474)

【行业观点碰撞】
1⃣@fradamt提出AI正使以太坊更有野心以应对后AI世界挑战，该观点获@barnabemonnot、@casparschwa、@_julianma、@corcoranwill等广泛认同与传播 [原文] (https://x.com/barnabemonnot/status/2111136356126925188)

2⃣@barnabemonnot建议AMC应在以太坊L1原生发行自身股份以获得最大安全性与可组合性，并通过L2与DeFi进行分销；@casparschwa转推支持 [原文] (https://x.com/barnabemonnot/status/2111060880733454664)
Charles Schwab已完成直接以太坊原生交易推广，所有客户现可访问Schwab Crypto进行以太坊交易 [原文] (https://x.com/davwals/status/2111096163869049265)

3⃣@growthepie_eth转推指出数万亿美元稳定币将在以太坊上流动；@base同日推动代币化股票、代理支付（x402）及稳定币企业卡等链上金融创新 [原文] (https://x.com/growthepie_eth/status/2111103906692391332)

4⃣@chainlink推出Fulcrum连接代币化证券与跨链融资场所，并宣布与Pacific Meta达成战略合作在日本推广机构代币化，采用CCIP与自动合规引擎 [原文] (https://x.com/chainlink/status/2111079920436674579)

5⃣@Asbet0s强调以太坊是面向企业与公共部门的开放、中立数字基础设施；@nloureiro转推ethdotorg新上线的组织使用指南 [原文] (https://x.com/Asbet0s/status/2111026495363903573)

6⃣@corcoranwill转推@ethereum官方表示，以太坊正以形式验证等手段实现更快升级且更少bug；@soispoke等从剑桥研讨会反馈称后量子安全与快速终结技术正加速落地 [原文] (https://x.com/corcoranwill/status/2111144070953468224)

7⃣@barnabemonnot调侃AI代理正在解决以太坊的"千年难题"——获取Sepolia测试网ETH，反映测试网资源分配与AI代理需求的碰撞 [原文] (https://x.com/barnabemonnot/status/2110990946125095398)

【开发者生态】
1⃣@austingriffith发布"Wedgie"开源DIY硬件钱包，使用三种常见零件与3D打印外壳（MIT许可），可作为@safe签名者并采用VRGDA定价；获@dankrad认可并将在Devcon开放硬件区展示 [原文] (https://x.com/austingriffith/status/2111105390368948680)

2⃣@ignaciohagopian转推@ethrex_client立场，认为ACDC将EIP-8025 DFI是错误的决定，不利于以太坊长期利益 [原文] (https://x.com/ignaciohagopian/status/2111089453146292538)

3⃣@DavideCrapis透露与@binji_x合作的dAI项目正推进v1，后续还将实现安全性、私有问责等改进 [原文] (https://x.com/DavideCrapis/status/2111177680070877516)@nixorokish转推提及Lighter EVM公共devnet已上线，为开发者提供新的测试与实验环境 [原文] (https://x.com/nixorokish/status/2110930474143268915)

4⃣@nixorokish转推@austingriffith的ethskills ChatGPT插件已获批，可增强AI对以太坊技术与生态的理解 [原文] (https://x.com/nixorokish/status/2110949080818147758)

5⃣@matteoikari宣布@Zac_Aztec项目达到Stage 2 L2里程碑，标志着去中心化与安全性进一步提升 [原文] (https://x.com/matteoikari/status/2111089285218566372)

6⃣@DavideCrapis转推VitalikButerin关于Wrapped zkAPI结合Tor、覆盖流量与本地LLM提示重写的隐私方案，为开发者提供抗审查与隐私保护思路 [原文] (https://x.com/DavideCrapis/status/2111081178186870833)

其他有趣内容：
1⃣@corcoranwill公布剑桥研讨会69个参与组织名单，涵盖全球顶尖大学、研究机构与行业团队，展现以太坊研究生态的广度与深度 [原文] (https://x.com/corcoranwill/status/2111105812097564797)

2⃣@growthepie_eth监测到Ronin L2出现740万笔交易与725万个地址的活动激增，但交易成本低导致链上利润暂时转负 [原文] (https://x.com/growthepie_eth/status/2111060869530427618)

3⃣@evan_van_ness转推指出，AI彻底打破了电子媒介的人类信任系统，因此区块链比以往任何时候都更加必要 [原文] (https://x.com/evan_van_ness/status/2110981884146831684)

4⃣@austingriffith转推@petejkim指出，比特币与以太坊选择secp256k1而非P-256深受对NSA后门恐惧的影响 [原文] (https://x.com/austingriffith/status/2111215339455623455)

hop.author: nero_eth
hop.excerpt:
It changes specs and forces all hegota + I* proposals to comply. Don't get me wrong, zkVMs are the future and new proposals should comply, but adding unnecessary complexities/dependencies early feels wrong.
The more nodes that drop state, the more difficult to bootstrap new nodes, and the bigger dtate grows the earlier we'll see nodes dropping data, no matter if named optional or not.

hop.author: growthepie_eth
hop.excerpt:
Huge activity spike on @Ronin_Network L2.

7.4 million transactions by 7.25 million addresses.

Throughput also rose, but not by much, suggesting these were low-complexity transactions. This is further supported by the drop in median transaction costs during the spike.

Transaction costs were so low that onchain profit turned into an onchain loss, as rent paid to L1 temporarily exceeded revenue.

items.text: @austingriffith转推@petejkim指出，比特币与以太坊选择secp256k1而非P-256深受对NSA后门恐惧的影响

hop.author: petejkim
hop.excerpt:
the choice of secp256k1 over r1 (P-256) in bitcoin (and ethereum) was heavily influenced by the fear of an NSA backdoor. this has been very annoying for wallet developers because the secure enclave chips found in most consumer devices only support r1. passkeys use r1 as well.

turns out there is no backdoor after all... amazing work by anthropic.

https://www.anthropic.com/research/ecdsa-curve-ori
